title: Colpey Calling x The Fix [10] with Lund Quartet
content:
10th July 2015

This week we welcomed Bristol’s Lund Quartet. One of the finest bands to have emerged out of the city in recent years, the foursome came to our attention following the release of their beautiful self-titled album in 2013.

The mix came about after a conversation we had during a train ride. Sometimes when doing live shows there is space for us to play some records before our performance. As Jake has two turntables to play the music, it gives us the opportunity to set a mood for the evening and play some of the music we enjoy. This is some of that music.
Lund Quartet
